```plato

    // The wedge (exterior) product a ^ b as a Bivector3D — the geometric-algebra
    // dual of the cross product under the shared right-hand convention: the
    // bivector components (YZ, ZX, XY) equal the (X, Y, Z) of a x b. Encodes the
    // oriented plane element (area and orientation) spanned by a and b.
    Wedge(a: Vector3D, b: Vector3D): Bivector3D
        => (
            a.Y * b.Z - a.Z * b.Y,
            a.Z * b.X - a.X * b.Z,
            a.X * b.Y - a.Y * b.X);
```
